1.text: In tha beginning was tha Word, N tha Word was wit God, N tha Word was God.
Tha same was in tha beginning wit God.
All things were made by him; N without him was not any thing made dat was made.
In him was life; N tha life was tha light of men.
N tha light shines in darkness; N tha darkness comprehended it not.
There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
Tha same came 4 a witness, 2 bear witness of tha Light, dat all men through him might believe.
He was not dat Light, but was sent 2 bear witness of dat Light.
Dat was tha true Light, which lighteth every man dat comes in2 tha world.
He was in tha world, N tha world was made by him, N tha world knew him not.
He came 2 his own, N his own received him not.
But as many as received him, 2 ’em gave he power 2 become tha sons of God, even 2 ’em dat believe on his name:
Which were born, not of blood, nor of tha will of tha flesh, nor of tha will of man, but of God.
N tha Word was made flesh, N lived among us, (N we beheld his glory, tha glory as of tha only begotten of tha Father,) full of grace N truth.
John bare witness of him, N cried, sayin, dis was he of whom I spoke, He dat comes after me is preferred before me: 4 he was before me.
N of his fulness have all we received, N grace 4 grace.
4 tha law was given by Moses, but grace N truth came by Jesus Christ.
No man has seen God at any time; tha only begotten Son, which is in tha bosom of tha Father, he has declared him.
N dis is tha record of John, when tha Jews sent priests N Levites from Jerusalem 2 ask him, Who r u?
N he confessed, N denied not; but confessed, I am not tha Christ.
N dey asked him, What then? r u Elias? N he says, I am not. r u dat prophet? N he answered, No.
Then said dey 2 him, Who r u? dat we may give an answer 2 ’em dat sent us. What sayest u of urself?
He said, I am tha voice of one cryin in tha wilderness, Make straight tha way of tha Lord, as said tha prophet Esaias.
N dey which were sent were of tha Pharisees.
N dey asked him, N said 2 him, Why baptizest u then, if u don’t be dat Christ, nor Elias, neither dat prophet?
John answered ’em, sayin, I baptize wit water: but there stands one among u, whom y’all know not;
He it is, who comin after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy 2 unloose.
Dese things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
Tha next day John sees Jesus comin 2 him, N says, look tha Lamb of God, which takes away tha sin of tha world.
Dis is he of whom I said, After me comes a man which is preferred before me: 4 he was before me.
N I knew him not: but dat he should be made manifest 2 Israel, therefore am I come baptizing wit water.
N John bare record, sayin, I saw tha Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, N it stayed upon him.
N I knew him not: but he dat sent me 2 baptize wit water, tha same said 2 me, Upon whom u will see tha Spirit descending, N remaining on him, tha same is he which baptizeth wit tha Holy Ghost.
N I saw, N bare record dat dis is tha Son of God.
Again tha next day after John stood, N two of his disciples;
N lookin upon Jesus as he walked, he says, look tha Lamb of God!
N tha two disciples heard him speak, N dey followed Jesus.
Then Jesus turned, N saw ’em followin, N says 2 ’em, What seek y’all? dey said 2 him, Rabbi, (which is 2 say, bein interpreted, Master,) where dwell u?
He says 2 ’em, Come N see. dey came N saw where he lived, N stayed wit him dat day: 4 it was about tha tenth hour.
One of tha two which heard John speak, N followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
He first finds his own brother Simon, N says 2 him, We have found tha Messias, which is, bein interpreted, tha Christ.
N he brought him 2 Jesus. N when Jesus beheld him, he said, u r Simon tha son of Jona: u will be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
Tha day followin Jesus would go forth in2 Galilee, N finds Philip, N says 2 him, Follow me.
Now Philip was of Bethsaida, tha city of Andrew N Peter.
Philip finds Nathanael, N says 2 him, We have found him, of whom Moses in tha law, N tha prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, tha son of Joseph.
N Nathanael said 2 him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip says 2 him, Come N see.
Jesus saw Nathanael comin 2 him, N says of him, look an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
Nathanael says 2 him, from where know u me? Jesus answered 2 him, Before dat Philip called u, when u were under tha fig tree, I saw u.
Nathanael answered N says 2 him, Rabbi, u r tha Son of God; u r tha King of Israel.
Jesus answered 2 him, Because I said 2 u, I saw u under tha fig tree, believe u? u will see greater things than dese.
N he says 2 him, for real, for real, I say 2 u, Hereafter y’all shall see heaven open, N tha angels of God ascending N descending upon tha Son of man.

2.text: N tha third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; N tha mother of Jesus was there:
N both Jesus was called, N his disciples, 2 tha marriage.
N when dey wanted wine, tha mother of Jesus says 2 him, dey have no wine.
Jesus says 2 her, Woman, what have I 2 do wit u? mine hour is not yet come.
His mother says 2 tha servants, whatever he says 2 u, do it.
N there were set there six waterpots of stone, after tha manner of tha purifying of tha Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
Jesus says 2 ’em, Fill tha waterpots wit water. N dey filled ’em up 2 tha brim.
N he says 2 ’em, Draw out now, N bear 2 tha governor of tha feast. N dey bare it.
When tha ruler of tha feast had tasted tha water dat was made wine, N knew not from where it was: (but tha servants which drew tha water knew;) tha governor of tha feast called tha bridegroom,
N says 2 him, Every man at tha beginning does set forth good wine; N when men have well drunk, then dat which is worse: but u have kept tha good wine until now.
Dis beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, N manifested forth his glory; N his disciples believed on him.
After dis he went down 2 Capernaum, he, N his mother, N his brothers, N his disciples: N dey continued there not many days.
N tha Jews’ passover was at hand, N Jesus went up 2 Jerusalem,
N found in tha temple dose dat sold oxen N sheep N doves, N tha changers of money sittin:
N when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove ’em all out of tha temple, N tha sheep, N tha oxen; N poured out tha changers’ money, N overthrew tha tables;
N said 2 ’em dat sold doves, Take dese things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.
N his disciples remembered dat it was written, tha zeal of thine house has eaten me up.
Then answered tha Jews N said 2 him, What sign show u 2 us, seein dat u do dese things?
Jesus answered 2 ’em, Destroy dis temple, N in three days I will raise it up.
Then said tha Jews, Forty N six years was dis temple in buildin, N will u rear it up in three days?
But he spoke of tha temple of his body.
When therefore he was risen from tha dead, his disciples remembered dat he had said dis 2 ’em; N dey believed tha scripture, N tha word which Jesus had said.
Now when he was in Jerusalem at tha passover, in tha feast day, many believed in his name, when dey saw tha miracles which he did.
But Jesus did not commit himself 2 ’em, because he knew all men,
N needed not dat any should testify of man: 4 he knew what was in man.

3.text: There was a man of tha Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of tha Jews:
Tha same came 2 Jesus by night, N said 2 him, Rabbi, we know dat u r a teacher come from God: 4 no man can do dese miracles dat u do, except God be wit him.
Jesus answered 2 him, for real, for real, I say 2 u, Except a man be born again, he cannot see tha kingdom of God.
Nicodemus says 2 him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter tha second time in2 his mother’s womb, N be born?
Jesus answered, for real, for real, I say 2 u, Except a man be born of water N of tha Spirit, he cannot enter in2 tha kingdom of God.
Dat which is born of tha flesh is flesh; N dat which is born of tha Spirit is spirit.
Marvel not dat I said 2 u, y’all must be born again.
Tha wind bloweth where it listeth, N u hear tha sound of it, but can not tell from where it comes, N where it goes: so is every one dat is born of tha Spirit.
Nicodemus answered 2 him, How can dese things be?
Jesus answered 2 him, r u a master of Israel, N know not dese things?
For real, for real, I say 2 u, We speak dat we do know, N testify dat we have seen; N y’all receive not our witness.
If I have told u earthly things, N y’all believe not, how shall y’all believe, if I tell u of heavenly things?
N no man has ascended up 2 heaven, but he dat came down from heaven, even tha Son of man which is in heaven.
N as Moses lifted up tha serpent in tha wilderness, even so must tha Son of man be lifted up:
Dat whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
4 God so loved tha world, dat he gave his only begotten Son, dat whoever believes in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
4 God sent not his Son in2 tha world 2 condemn tha world; but dat tha world through him might be saved.
He dat believes on him is not condemned: but he dat believes not is condemned already, because he has not believed in tha name of tha only begotten Son of God.
N dis is tha condemnation, dat light is come in2 tha world, N men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
4 every one dat does evil hates tha light, neither comes 2 tha light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
But he dat does truth comes 2 tha light, dat his deeds may be made manifest, dat dey r wrought in God.
After dese things came Jesus N his disciples in2 tha land of Judæa; N there he tarried wit ’em, N baptized.
N John also was baptizing in Ænon near 2 Salim, because there was much water there: N dey came, N were baptized.
4 John was not yet cast in2 prison.
Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples N tha Jews about purifying.
N dey came 2 John, N said 2 him, Rabbi, he dat was wit u beyond Jordan, 2 whom u bore witness, look, tha same baptizeth, N all men come 2 him.
John answered, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
y’all y’all bear me witness, dat I said, I am not tha Christ, but dat I am sent before him.
He dat has tha bride is tha bridegroom: but tha friend of tha bridegroom, which stands N hears him, rejoices greatly because of tha bridegroom’s voice: dis my joy therefore is fulfilled.
He must increase, but I must decrease.
He dat comes from above is above all: he dat is of tha earth is earthly, N speaks of tha earth: he dat comes from heaven is above all.
N what he has seen N heard, dat he testifieth; N no man receives his testimony.
He dat has received his testimony has set 2 his seal dat God is true.
4 he whom God has sent speaks tha words of God: 4 God gives not tha Spirit by measure 2 him.
Tha Father loves tha Son, N has given all things in2 his hand.
He dat believes on tha Son has everlasting life: N he dat believes not tha Son shall not see life; but tha wrath of God abides on him.

4.text: When therefore tha Lord knew how tha Pharisees had heard dat Jesus made N baptized more disciples than John,
(Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
He left Judæa, N departed again in2 Galilee.
N he must needs go through Samaria.
Then comes he 2 a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near 2 tha parcel of ground dat Jacob gave 2 his son Joseph.
Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, bein wearied wit his journey, sat like dis on tha well: N it was about tha sixth hour.
There comes a woman of Samaria 2 draw water: Jesus says 2 her, Give me 2 drink.
(4 his disciples were gone away 2 tha city 2 buy food.)
Then says tha woman of Samaria 2 him, How is it dat u, bein a Jew, ask drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? 4 tha Jews have no dealings wit tha Samaritans.
Jesus answered 2 her, If u knew tha gift of God, N who it is dat says 2 u, Give me 2 drink; u would have asked of him, N he would have given u livin water.
Tha woman says 2 him, Sir, u have nothing 2 draw wit, N tha well is deep: from from where then have u dat livin water?
R u greater than our father Jacob, which gave us tha well, N drank of it himself, N his children, N his cattle?
Jesus answered 2 her, whoever drinks of dis water shall thirst again:
But whoever drinks of tha water dat I shall give him shall never thirst; but tha water dat I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up in2 everlasting life.
Tha woman says 2 him, Sir, give me dis water, dat I thirst not, neither come here 2 draw.
Jesus says 2 her, Go, call ur husband, N come here.
Tha woman answered, I have no husband. Jesus said 2 her, u have well said, I have no husband:
4 u have had five husbands; N he whom u now have is not ur husband: in dat said u truly.
Tha woman says 2 him, Sir, I perceive dat u r a prophet.
Our fathers worshipped in dis mountain; N y’all say, dat in Jerusalem is tha place where men ought 2 worship.
Jesus says 2 her, Woman, believe me, tha hour comes, when y’all shall neither in dis mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship tha Father.
y’all worship y’all know not what: we know what we worship: 4 salvation is of tha Jews.
But tha hour comes, N now is, when tha true worshippers shall worship tha Father in spirit N in truth: 4 tha Father seeks such 2 worship him.
God is a Spirit: N dey dat worship him must worship him in spirit N in truth.
Tha woman says 2 him, I know dat Messias comes, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
Jesus says 2 her, I dat speak 2 u am he.
N upon dis came his disciples, N marvelled dat he talked wit tha woman: yet no man said, What seek u? or, Why talkest u wit her?
Tha woman then left her waterpot, N went her way in2 tha city, N says 2 tha men,
Come, see a man, which told me all things dat ever I did: is not dis tha Christ?
Then dey went out of tha city, N came 2 him.
In tha mean while his disciples prayed him, sayin, Master, eat.
But he said 2 ’em, I have food 2 eat dat y’all know not of.
Therefore said tha disciples one 2 another, has any man brought him ought 2 eat?
Jesus says 2 ’em, My food is 2 do tha will of him dat sent me, N 2 finish his work.
Say not y’all, There r yet four months, N then comes harvest? look, I say 2 u, Lift up ur eyes, N look on tha fields; 4 dey r white already 2 harvest.
N he dat reapeth receives wages, N gathers fruit 2 life eternal: dat both he dat sows N he dat reapeth may rejoice together.
N in dis is dat sayin true, One sows, N another reapeth.
I sent u 2 reap dat whereon y’all bestowed no labour: other men laboured, N y’all r entered in2 their labours.
N many of tha Samaritans of dat city believed on him 4 tha sayin of tha woman, which testified, He told me all dat ever I did.
So when tha Samaritans were come 2 him, dey besought him dat he would tarry wit ’em: N he stayed there two days.
N many more believed because of his own word;
N said 2 tha woman, Now we believe, not because of ur sayin: 4 we have heard him ourselves, N know dat dis is indeed tha Christ, tha Saviour of tha world.
Now after two days he departed thence, N went in2 Galilee.
4 Jesus himself testified, dat a prophet has no honour in his own country.
Then when he was come in2 Galilee, tha Galilæans received him, havin seen all tha things dat he did at Jerusalem at tha feast: 4 dey also went 2 tha feast.
So Jesus came again in2 Cana of Galilee, where he made tha water wine. N there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
When he heard dat Jesus was come out of Judæa in2 Galilee, he went 2 him, N besought him dat he would come down, N heal his son: 4 he was at tha point of death.
Then said Jesus 2 him, Except y’all see signs N wonders, y’all will not believe.
Tha nobleman says 2 him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
Jesus says 2 him, Go ur way; ur son lives. N tha man believed tha word dat Jesus had spoken 2 him, N he went his way.
N as he was now goin down, his servants met him, N told him, sayin, ur son lives.
Then enquired he of ’em tha hour when he began 2 amend. N dey said 2 him, Yesterday at tha seventh hour tha fever left him.
So tha father knew dat it was at tha same hour, in tha which Jesus said 2 him, ur son lives: N himself believed, N his whole house.
Dis is again tha second miracle dat Jesus did, when he was come out of Judæa in2 Galilee.

5.text: After dis there was a feast of tha Jews; N Jesus went up 2 Jerusalem.
Now there is at Jerusalem by tha sheep market a pool, which is called in tha Hebrew tongue Bethesda, havin five porches.
In dese lay a great crowd of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waitin 4 tha movin of tha water.
4 an angel went down at a certain season in2 tha pool, N troubled tha water: whoever then first after tha troublin of tha water stepped in was made whole of whatever disease he had.
N a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty N eight years.
When Jesus saw him lie, N knew dat he had been now a long time in dat case, he says 2 him, will u be made whole?
Tha impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when tha water is troubled, 2 put me in2 tha pool: but while I am comin, another steppeth down before me.
Jesus says 2 him, Rise, take up ur bed, N walk.
N right away tha man was made whole, N took up his bed, N walked: N on tha same day was tha sabbath.
Tha Jews therefore said 2 him dat was cured, It is tha sabbath day: it is not lawful 4 u 2 carry ur bed.
He answered ’em, He dat made me whole, tha same said 2 me, Take up ur bed, N walk.
Then asked dey him, What man is dat which said 2 u, Take up ur bed, N walk?
N he dat was healed knew not who it was: 4 Jesus had conveyed himself away, a crowd bein in dat place.
Afterward Jesus finds him in tha temple, N said 2 him, look, u r made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come 2 u.
Tha man departed, N told tha Jews dat it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
N therefore did tha Jews persecute Jesus, N sought 2 kill him, because he had done dese things on tha sabbath day.
But Jesus answered ’em, My Father works until now, N I work.
Therefore tha Jews sought tha more 2 kill him, because he not only had broken tha sabbath, but said also dat God was his Father, makin himself equal wit God.
Then answered Jesus N said 2 ’em, for real, for real, I say 2 u, tha Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees tha Father do: 4 what things soever he does, dese also does tha Son likewise.
4 tha Father loves tha Son, N shows him all things dat himself does: N he will show him greater works than dese, dat y’all may marvel.
4 as tha Father raises up tha dead, N quickeneth ’em; even so tha Son quickeneth whom he will.
4 tha Father judges no man, but has committed all judgment 2 tha Son:
Dat all men should honour tha Son, even as dey honour tha Father. He dat honors not tha Son honors not tha Father which has sent him.
For real, for real, I say 2 u, He dat hears my word, N believes on him dat sent me, has everlasting life, N shall not come in2 condemnation; but is passed from death 2 life.
For real, for real, I say 2 u, tha hour is comin, N now is, when tha dead shall hear tha voice of tha Son of God: N dey dat hear shall live.
4 as tha Father has life in himself; so has he given 2 tha Son 2 have life in himself;
N has given him authority 2 execute judgment also, because he is tha Son of man.
Marvel not at dis: 4 tha hour is comin, in tha which all dat r in tha graves shall hear his voice,
N shall come forth; dey dat have done good, 2 tha resurrection of life; N dey dat have done evil, 2 tha resurrection of damnation.
I can of my own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: N my judgment is just; because I seek not my own will, but tha will of tha Father which has sent me.
If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
There is another dat bears witness of me; N I know dat tha witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
y’all sent 2 John, N he bare witness 2 tha truth.
But I receive not testimony from man: but dese things I say, dat y’all might be saved.
He was a burnin N a shinin light: N y’all were willin 4 a season 2 rejoice in his light.
But I have greater witness than dat of John: 4 tha works which tha Father has given me 2 finish, tha same works dat I do, bear witness of me, dat tha Father has sent me.
N tha Father himself, which has sent me, has borne witness of me. y’all have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
N y’all have not his word abiding in u: 4 whom he has sent, him y’all believe not.
Search tha scriptures; 4 in ’em y’all think y’all have eternal life: N dey r dey which testify of me.
N y’all will not come 2 me, dat y’all might have life.
I receive not honour from men.
But I know u, dat y’all have not tha love of God in u.
I am come in my Father’s name, N y’all receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him y’all will receive.
How can y’all believe, which receive honour one of another, N seek not tha honour dat comes from God only?
Do not think dat I will accuse u 2 tha Father: there is one dat accuseth u, even Moses, in whom y’all trust.
4 had y’all believed Moses, y’all would have believed me: 4 he wrote of me.
But if y’all believe not his writings, how shall y’all believe my words?

6.text: After dese things Jesus went over tha sea of Galilee, which is tha sea of Tiberias.
N a great crowd followed him, because dey saw his miracles which he did on ’em dat were diseased.
N Jesus went up in2 a mountain, N there he sat wit his disciples.
N tha passover, a feast of tha Jews, was nigh.
When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, N saw a great company come 2 him, he says 2 Philip, from where shall we buy bread, dat dese may eat?
N dis he said 2 prove him: 4 he himself knew what he would do.
Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient 4 ’em, dat every one of ’em may take a little.
One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, says 2 him,
There is a lad here, which has five barley loaves, N two small fishes: but what r dey among so many?
N Jesus said, Make tha men sit down. Now there was much grass in tha place. So tha men sat down, in number about five thousand.
N Jesus took tha loaves; N when he had given thanks, he distributed 2 tha disciples, N tha disciples 2 ’em dat were set down; N likewise of tha fishes as much as dey would.
When dey were filled, he said 2 his disciples, Gather up tha fragments dat remain, dat nothing be lost.
Therefore dey gathered ’em together, N filled twelve baskets wit tha fragments of tha five barley loaves, which remained over N above 2 ’em dat had eaten.
Then dose men, when dey had seen tha miracle dat Jesus did, said, dis is of a truth dat prophet dat should come in2 tha world.
When Jesus therefore perceived dat dey would come N take him by force, 2 make him a king, he departed again in2 a mountain himself alone.
N when even was now come, his disciples went down 2 tha sea,
N entered in2 a ship, N went over tha sea toward Capernaum. N it was now dark, N Jesus was not come 2 ’em.
N tha sea arose by reason of a great wind dat blew.
So when dey had rowed about five N twenty or thirty furlongs, dey see Jesus walkin on tha sea, N drawing nigh 2 tha ship: N dey were afraid.
But he says 2 ’em, It is I; don’t be afraid.
Then dey willingly received him in2 tha ship: N right away tha ship was at tha land where dey went.

Tha day followin, when tha people which stood on tha other side of tha sea saw dat there was none other boat there, save dat one whereinto his disciples were entered, N dat Jesus went not wit his disciples in2 tha boat, but dat his disciples were gone away alone;
(but there came other boats from Tiberias nigh 2 tha place where dey did eat bread, after dat tha Lord had given thanks:)
When tha people therefore saw dat Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, dey also took shipping, N came 2 Capernaum, seekin 4 Jesus.
N when dey had found him on tha other side of tha sea, dey said 2 him, Rabbi, when came u here?
Jesus answered ’em N said, for real, for real, I say 2 u, y’all seek me, not because y’all saw tha miracles, but because y’all did eat of tha loaves, N were filled.
Labour not 4 tha food which perishes, but 4 dat food which endures 2 everlasting life, which tha Son of man shall give 2 u: 4 him has God tha Father sealed.
Then said dey 2 him, What shall we do, dat we might work tha works of God?
Jesus answered 2 ’em, dis is tha work of God, dat y’all believe on him whom he has sent.
Dey said therefore 2 him, What sign show u then, dat we may see, N believe u? what do u work?
Our fathers did eat manna in tha desert; as it is written, He gave ’em bread from heaven 2 eat.
Then Jesus said 2 ’em, for real, for real, I say 2 u, Moses gave u not dat bread from heaven; but my Father gives u tha true bread from heaven.
4 tha bread of God is he which comes down from heaven, N gives life 2 tha world.
Then said dey 2 him, Lord, evermore give us dis bread.
N Jesus said 2 ’em, I am tha bread of life: he dat comes 2 me shall never hunger; N he dat believes on me shall never thirst.
But I said 2 u, dat y’all also have seen me, N believe not.
All dat tha Father gives me shall come 2 me; N him dat comes 2 me I will in no wise cast out.
4 I came down from heaven, not 2 do my own will, but tha will of him dat sent me.
N dis is tha Father’s will which has sent me, dat of all which he has given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at tha last day.
N dis is tha will of him dat sent me, dat every one which sees tha Son, N believes on him, may have everlasting life: N I will raise him up at tha last day.
Tha Jews then grumbled at him, because he said, I am tha bread which came down from heaven.
N dey said, Is not dis Jesus, tha son of Joseph, whose father N mother we know? how is it then dat he says, I came down from heaven?
Jesus therefore answered 2 ’em, grumble not among y’all.
No man can come 2 me, except tha Father which has sent me draw him: N I will raise him up at tha last day.
It is written in tha prophets, N dey shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore dat has heard, N has learned of tha Father, comes 2 me.
Not dat any man has seen tha Father, save he which is of God, he has seen tha Father.
For real, for real, I say 2 u, He dat believes on me has everlasting life.
I am dat bread of life.
Ur fathers did eat manna in tha wilderness, N r dead.
Dis is tha bread which comes down from heaven, dat a man may eat of it, N not die.
I am tha livin bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of dis bread, he shall live 4 ever: N tha bread dat I will give is my flesh, which I will give 4 tha life of tha world.
Tha Jews therefore strove among themselves, sayin, How can dis man give us his flesh 2 eat?
Then Jesus said 2 ’em, for real, for real, I say 2 u, Except y’all eat tha flesh of tha Son of man, N drink his blood, y’all have no life in u.
Whoever eats my flesh, N drinks my blood, has eternal life; N I will raise him up at tha last day.
4 my flesh is food indeed, N my blood is drink indeed.
He dat eats my flesh, N drinks my blood, lives in me, N I in him.
As tha livin Father has sent me, N I live by tha Father: so he dat eats me, even he shall live by me.
Dis is dat bread which came down from heaven: not as ur fathers did eat manna, N r dead: he dat eats of dis bread shall live 4 ever.
Dese things said he in tha synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
Many therefore of his disciples, when dey had heard dis, said, dis is an hard sayin; who can hear it?
When Jesus knew in himself dat his disciples grumbled at it, he said 2 ’em, does dis offend u?
What N if y’all shall see tha Son of man ascend up where he was before?
It is tha spirit dat quickeneth; tha flesh profits nothing: tha words dat I speak 2 u, dey r spirit, N dey r life.
But there r some of u dat believe not. 4 Jesus knew from tha beginning who dey were dat believed not, N who should betray him.
N he said, Therefore said I 2 u, dat no man can come 2 me, except it were given 2 him of my Father.
From dat time many of his disciples went back, N walked no more wit him.
Then said Jesus 2 tha twelve, Will y’all also go away?
Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, 2 whom shall we go? u have tha words of eternal life.
N we believe N r sure dat u r dat Christ, tha Son of tha livin God.
Jesus answered ’em, Have not I chosen u twelve, N one of u is a devil?
He spoke of Judas Iscariot tha son of Simon: 4 he it was dat should betray him, bein one of tha twelve.

7.text: After dese things Jesus walked in Galilee: 4 he would not walk in Jewry, because tha Jews sought 2 kill him.
Now tha Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.
His brothers therefore said 2 him, Depart hence, N go in2 Judæa, dat ur disciples also may see tha works dat u do.
4 there is no man dat does any thing in secret, N he himself seeks 2 be known openly. If u do dese things, show urself 2 tha world.
4 neither did his brothers believe in him.
Then Jesus said 2 ’em, My time is not yet come: but ur time is alway ready.
Tha world cannot hate u; but me it hates, because I testify of it, dat tha works of it r evil.
Go y’all up 2 dis feast: I go not up yet 2 dis feast; 4 my time is not yet full come.
When he had said dese words 2 ’em, he stayed still in Galilee.
But when his brothers were gone up, then went he also up 2 tha feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
Then tha Jews sought him at tha feast, N said, Where is he?
N there was much grumblin among tha people concerning him: 4 some said, He is a good man: others said, no; but he deceives tha people.
But no man spoke openly of him 4 fear of tha Jews.
Now about tha midst of tha feast Jesus went up in2 tha temple, N taught.
N tha Jews marvelled, sayin, How knows dis man letters, havin never learned?
Jesus answered ’em, N said, My doctrine is not mine, but his dat sent me.
If any man will do his will, he shall know of tha doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
He dat speaks of himself seeks his own glory: but he dat seeks his glory dat sent him, tha same is true, N no unrighteousness is in him.
Did not Moses give u tha law, N yet none of u keeps tha law? Why go y’all about 2 kill me?
Tha people answered, u have a devil: who goes about 2 kill u?
Jesus answered 2 ’em, I have done one work, N y’all all marvel.
Moses therefore gave 2 u circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of tha fathers;) N y’all on tha sabbath day circumcise a man.
If a man on tha sabbath day receive circumcision, dat tha law of Moses should not be broken; r y’all angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on tha sabbath day?
Judge not according 2 tha appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
Then said some of ’em of Jerusalem, Is not dis he, whom dey seek 2 kill?
But, look, he speaks boldly, N dey say nothing 2 him. Do tha rulers know indeed dat dis is tha very Christ?
But we know dis man from where he is: but when Christ comes, no man knows from where he is.
Then cried Jesus in tha temple as he taught, sayin, y’all both know me, N y’all know from where I am: N I am not come of myself, but he dat sent me is true, whom y’all know not.
But I know him: 4 I am from him, N he has sent me.
Then dey sought 2 take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
N many of tha people believed on him, N said, When Christ comes, will he do more miracles than dese which dis man has done?
Tha Pharisees heard dat tha people grumbled such things concerning him; N tha Pharisees N tha chief priests sent officers 2 take him.
Then said Jesus 2 ’em, Yet a little while am I wit u, N then I go 2 him dat sent me.
y’all shall seek me, N shall not find me: N where I am, there y’all cannot come.
Then said tha Jews among themselves, where will he go, dat we shall not find him? will he go 2 tha dispersed among tha Gentiles, N teach tha Gentiles?
What manner of sayin is dis dat he said, y’all shall seek me, N shall not find me: N where I am, there y’all cannot come?
In tha last day, dat great day of tha feast, Jesus stood N cried, sayin, If any man thirst, let him come 2 me, N drink.
He dat believes on me, as tha scripture has said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of livin water.
(But dis spoke he of tha Spirit, which dey dat believe on him should receive: 4 tha Holy Ghost was not yet given; because dat Jesus was not yet glorified.)
Many of tha people therefore, when dey heard dis sayin, said, Of a truth dis is tha Prophet.
Others said, dis is tha Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
Has not tha scripture said, dat Christ comes of tha seed of David, N out of tha town of Bethlehem, where David was?
So there was a division among tha people because of him.
N some of ’em would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
Then came tha officers 2 tha chief priests N Pharisees; N dey said 2 ’em, Why have y’all not brought him?
Tha officers answered, Never man spoke like dis man.
Then answered ’em tha Pharisees, r y’all also deceived?
Have any of tha rulers or of tha Pharisees believed on him?
But dis people who knows not tha law r cursed.
Nicodemus says 2 ’em, (he dat came 2 Jesus by night, bein one of ’em,)
Does our law judge any man, before it hear him, N know what he does?
Dey answered 2 him, r u also of Galilee? Search, N look: 4 out of Galilee arises no prophet.
N every man went 2 his own house.

8.text: Jesus went 2 tha mount of Olives.
N early in tha morning he came again in2 tha temple, N all tha people came 2 him; N he sat down, N taught ’em.
N tha scribes N Pharisees brought 2 him a woman taken in adultery; N when dey had set her in tha midst,
Dey say 2 him, Master, dis woman was taken in adultery, in tha very act.
Now Moses in tha law commanded us, dat such should be stoned: but what sayest u?
Dis dey said, tempting him, dat dey might have 2 accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, N wit his finger wrote on tha ground, as though he heard ’em not.
So when dey continued asking him, he lifted up himself, N said 2 ’em, He dat is without sin among u, let him first cast a stone at her.
N again he stooped down, N wrote on tha ground.
N dey which heard it, bein convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at tha eldest, even 2 tha last: N Jesus was left alone, N tha woman standin in tha midst.
When Jesus had lifted up himself, N saw none but tha woman, he said 2 her, Woman, where r dose thine accusers? has no man condemned u?
She said, No man, Lord. N Jesus said 2 her, Neither do I condemn u: go, N sin no more.
Then spoke Jesus again 2 ’em, sayin, I am tha light of tha world: he dat follows me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have tha light of life.
Tha Pharisees therefore said 2 him, u bear record of urself; ur record is not true.
Jesus answered 2 ’em, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: 4 I know from where I came, N where I go; but y’all cannot tell from where I come, N where I go.
y’all judge after tha flesh; I judge no man.
N yet if I judge, my judgment is true: 4 I am not alone, but I N tha Father dat sent me.
It is also written in ur law, dat tha testimony of two men is true.
I am one dat bear witness of myself, N tha Father dat sent me bears witness of me.
Then said dey 2 him, Where is ur Father? Jesus answered, y’all neither know me, nor my Father: if y’all had known me, y’all should have known my Father also.
Dese words spoke Jesus in tha treasury, as he taught in tha temple: N no man laid hands on him; 4 his hour was not yet come.
Then said Jesus again 2 ’em, I go my way, N y’all shall seek me, N shall die in ur sins: where I go, y’all cannot come.
Then said tha Jews, Will he kill himself? because he says, where I go, y’all cannot come.
N he said 2 ’em, y’all r from beneath; I am from above: y’all r of dis world; I am not of dis world.
I said therefore 2 u, dat y’all shall die in ur sins: 4 if y’all believe not dat I am he, y’all shall die in ur sins.
Then said dey 2 him, Who r u? N Jesus says 2 ’em, Even tha same dat I said 2 u from tha beginning.
I have many things 2 say N 2 judge of u: but he dat sent me is true; N I speak 2 tha world dose things which I have heard of him.
Dey understood not dat he spoke 2 ’em of tha Father.
Then said Jesus 2 ’em, When y’all have lifted up tha Son of man, then shall y’all know dat I am he, N dat I do nothing of myself; but as my Father has taught me, I speak dese things.
N he dat sent me is wit me: tha Father has not left me alone; 4 I do always dose things dat please him.
As he spoke dese words, many believed on him.
Then said Jesus 2 dose Jews which believed on him, If y’all continue in my word, then r y’all my disciples indeed;
N y’all shall know tha truth, N tha truth shall make u free.
Dey answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, N were never in bondage 2 any man: how sayest u, y’all shall be made free?
Jesus answered ’em, for real, for real, I say 2 u, whoever commits sin is tha servant of sin.
N tha servant abides not in tha house 4 ever: but tha Son abides ever.
If tha Son therefore shall make u free, y’all shall be free indeed.
I know dat y’all r Abraham’s seed; but y’all seek 2 kill me, because my word has no place in u.
I speak dat which I have seen wit my Father: N y’all do dat which y’all have seen wit ur father.
Dey answered 2 him, Abraham is our father. Jesus says 2 ’em, If y’all were Abraham’s children, y’all would do tha works of Abraham.
But now y’all seek 2 kill me, a man dat has told u tha truth, which I have heard of God: dis did not Abraham.
y’all do tha deeds of ur father. Then said dey 2 him, We don’t be born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
Jesus said 2 ’em, If God were ur Father, y’all would love me: 4 I proceeded forth N came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
Why do y’all not understand my speech? even because y’all cannot hear my word.

y’all r of ur father tha devil, N tha lusts of ur father y’all will do. He was a murderer from tha beginning, N stayed not in tha truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: 4 he is a liar, N tha father of it.
N because I tell u tha truth, y’all believe me not.
Which of u convinceth me of sin? N if I say tha truth, why do y’all not believe me?
He dat is of God hears God’s words: y’all therefore hear ’em not, because y’all r not of God.
Then answered tha Jews, N said 2 him, Say we not well dat u r a Samaritan, N have a devil?
Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, N y’all do dishonour me.
N I seek not my own glory: there is one dat seeks N judges.
For real, for real, I say 2 u, If a man keep my sayin, he shall never see death.
Then said tha Jews 2 him, Now we know dat u have a devil. Abraham is dead, N tha prophets; N u sayest, If a man keep my sayin, he shall never taste of death.
R u greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? N tha prophets r dead: whom make u urself?
Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father dat honors me; of whom y’all say, dat he is ur God:
Yet y’all have not known him; but I know him: N if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like 2 u: but I know him, N keep his sayin.
Ur father Abraham rejoiced 2 see my day: N he saw it, N was glad.
Then said tha Jews 2 him, u r not yet fifty years old, N have u seen Abraham?
Jesus said 2 ’em, for real, for real, I say 2 u, Before Abraham was, I am.
Then took dey up stones 2 cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, N went out of tha temple, goin through tha midst of ’em, N so passed by.

9.text: N as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
N his disciples asked him, sayin, Master, who did sin, dis man, or his parents, dat he was born blind?
Jesus answered, Neither has dis man sinned, nor his parents: but dat tha works of God should be made manifest in him.
I must work tha works of him dat sent me, while it is day: tha night comes, when no man can work.
As long as I am in tha world, I am tha light of tha world.
When he had like dis spoken, he spat on tha ground, N made clay of tha spittle, N he anointed tha eyes of tha blind man wit tha clay,
N said 2 him, Go, wash in tha pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, N washed, N came seein.
Tha neighbours therefore, N dey which before had seen him dat he was blind, said, Is not dis he dat sat N begged?
Some said, dis is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
Therefore said dey 2 him, How were ur eyes opened?
He answered, A man dat is called Jesus made clay, N anointed my eyes, N said 2 me, Go 2 tha pool of Siloam, N wash: N I went N washed, N I received sight.
Then said dey 2 him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
Dey brought 2 tha Pharisees him dat aforetime was blind.
N it was tha sabbath day when Jesus made tha clay, N opened his eyes.
Then again tha Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said 2 ’em, He put clay upon my eyes, N I washed, N do see.
Therefore said some of tha Pharisees, dis man is not of God, because he keeps not tha sabbath day. Others said, How can a man dat is a sinner do such miracles? N there was a division among ’em.
Dey say 2 tha blind man again, What sayest u of him, dat he has opened ur eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
But tha Jews did not believe concerning him, dat he had been blind, N received his sight, until dey called tha parents of him dat had received his sight.
N dey asked ’em, sayin, Is dis ur son, who y’all say was born blind? how then does he now see?
His parents answered ’em N said, We know dat dis is our son, N dat he was born blind:
But by what means he now sees, we know not; or who has opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak 4 himself.
Dese words spoke his parents, because dey feared tha Jews: 4 tha Jews had agreed already, dat if any man did confess dat he was Christ, he should be put out of tha synagogue.
Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
Then again called dey tha man dat was blind, N said 2 him, Give God tha praise: we know dat dis man is a sinner.
He answered, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, dat, whereas I was blind, now I see.
Then said dey 2 him again, What did he 2 u? how opened he ur eyes?
He answered ’em, I have told u already, N y’all did not hear: so would y’all hear it again? will y’all also be his disciples?
Then dey reviled him, N said, u r his disciple; but we r Moses’ disciples.
We know dat God spoke 2 Moses: as 4 dis fellow, we know not from from where he is.
Tha man answered 2 ’em, Why in dis is a marvellous thing, dat y’all know not from from where he is, N yet he has opened my eyes.
Now we know dat God hears not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, N does his will, him he hears.
Since tha world began was it not heard dat any man opened tha eyes of one dat was born blind.
If dis man were not of God, he could do nothing.
Dey answered 2 him, u were altogether born in sins, N do u teach us? N dey cast him out.
Jesus heard dat dey had cast him out; N when he had found him, he said 2 him, do u believe on tha Son of God?
He answered, Who is he, Lord, dat I might believe on him?
N Jesus said 2 him, u have both seen him, N it is he dat talketh wit u.
N he said, Lord, I believe. N he worshipped him.
N Jesus said, 4 judgment I am come in2 dis world, dat dey which see not might see; N dat dey which see might be made blind.
N some of tha Pharisees which were wit him heard dese words, N said 2 him, r we blind also?
Jesus said 2 ’em, If y’all were blind, y’all should have no sin: but now y’all say, We see; therefore ur sin remains.

10.text: For real, for real, I say 2 u, He dat enters not by tha door in2 tha sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, tha same is a thief N a robber.
But he dat enters in by tha door is tha shepherd of tha sheep.
2 him tha porter opens; N tha sheep hear his voice: N he calls his own sheep by name, N leads ’em out.
N when he puts forth his own sheep, he goes before ’em, N tha sheep follow him: 4 dey know his voice.
N a stranger will dey not follow, but will flee from him: 4 dey know not tha voice of strangers.
Dis parable spoke Jesus 2 ’em: but dey understood not what things dey were which he spoke 2 ’em.
Then said Jesus 2 ’em again, for real, for real, I say 2 u, I am tha door of tha sheep.
All dat ever came before me r thieves N robbers: but tha sheep did not hear ’em.
I am tha door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, N shall go in N out, N find pasture.
Tha thief comes not, but 4 2 steal, N 2 kill, N 2 destroy: I am come dat dey might have life, N dat dey might have it more abundantly.
I am tha good shepherd: tha good shepherd gives his life 4 tha sheep.
But he dat is an hireling, N not tha shepherd, whose own tha sheep r not, sees tha wolf comin, N leaves tha sheep, N flees: N tha wolf catcheth ’em, N scatters tha sheep.
Tha hireling flees, because he is an hireling, N cares not 4 tha sheep.
I am tha good shepherd, N know my sheep, N am known of mine.
As tha Father knows me, even so know I tha Father: N I lay down my life 4 tha sheep.
N other sheep I have, which r not of dis fold: ’em also I must bring, N dey shall hear my voice; N there shall be one fold, N one shepherd.
Therefore does my Father love me, because I lay down my life, dat I might take it again.
No man takes it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power 2 lay it down, N I have power 2 take it again. dis commandment have I received of my Father.
There was a division therefore again among tha Jews 4 dese sayings.
N many of ’em said, He has a devil, N is mad; why hear y’all him?
Others said, dese r not tha words of him dat has a devil. Can a devil open tha eyes of tha blind?
N it was at Jerusalem tha feast of tha dedication, N it was winter.
N Jesus walked in tha temple in Solomon’s porch.
Then came tha Jews round about him, N said 2 him, How long do u make us 2 doubt? If u be tha Christ, tell us plainly.
Jesus answered ’em, I told u, N y’all believed not: tha works dat I do in my Father’s name, dey bear witness of me.
But y’all believe not, because y’all r not of my sheep, as I said 2 u.
My sheep hear my voice, N I know ’em, N dey follow me:
N I give 2 ’em eternal life; N dey shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck ’em out of my hand.
My Father, which gave ’em me, is greater than all; N no man is able 2 pluck ’em out of my Father’s hand.
I N my Father r one.
Then tha Jews took up stones again 2 stone him.
Jesus answered ’em, Many good works have I showed u from my Father; 4 which of dose works do y’all stone me?
Tha Jews answered him, sayin, 4 a good work we stone u not; but 4 blasphemy; N because dat u, bein a man, make urself God.
Jesus answered ’em, Is it not written in ur law, I said, y’all r gods?
If he called ’em gods, 2 whom tha word of God came, N tha scripture cannot be broken;
Say y’all of him, whom tha Father has sanctified, N sent in2 tha world, u blasphemest; because I said, I am tha Son of God?
If I do not tha works of my Father, believe me not.
But if I do, though y’all believe not me, believe tha works: dat y’all may know, N believe, dat tha Father is in me, N I in him.
Therefore dey sought again 2 take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
N went away again beyond Jordan in2 tha place where John at first baptized; N there he stayed.
N many resorted 2 him, N said, John did no miracle: but all things dat John spoke of dis man were true.
N many believed on him there.

11.text: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, tha town of Mary N her sister Martha.
(It was dat Mary which anointed tha Lord wit ointment, N wiped his feet wit her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
Therefore his sisters sent 2 him, sayin, Lord, look, he whom u love is sick.
When Jesus heard dat, he said, dis sickness is not 2 death, but 4 tha glory of God, dat tha Son of God might be glorified by dat.
Now Jesus loved Martha, N her sister, N Lazarus.
When he had heard therefore dat he was sick, he stayed two days still in tha same place where he was.
Then after dat says he 2 his disciples, Let us go in2 Judæa again.
His disciples say 2 him, Master, tha Jews of late sought 2 stone u; N go u there again?
Jesus answered, r there not twelve hours in tha day? If any man walk in tha day, he stumbleth not, because he sees tha light of dis world.
But if a man walk in tha night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
Dese things said he: N after dat he says 2 ’em, Our friend Lazarus sleeps; but I go, dat I may awake him out of sleep.
Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
But Jesus spoke of his death: but dey thought dat he had spoken of takin of rest in sleep.
Then said Jesus 2 ’em plainly, Lazarus is dead.
N I am glad 4 ur sakes dat I was not there, 2 tha intent y’all may believe; nevertheless let us go 2 him.
Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, 2 his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, dat we may die wit him.
Then when Jesus came, he found dat he had lain in tha grave four days already.
Now Bethany was nigh 2 Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
N many of tha Jews came 2 Martha N Mary, 2 comfort ’em concerning their brother.
Then Martha, as soon as she heard dat Jesus was comin, went N met him: but Mary sat still in tha house.
Then said Martha 2 Jesus, Lord, if u had been here, my brother had not died.
But I know, dat even now, whatever u will ask of God, God will give it u.
Jesus says 2 her, ur brother shall rise again.
Martha says 2 him, I know dat he shall rise again in tha resurrection at tha last day.
Jesus said 2 her, I am tha resurrection, N tha life: he dat believes in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
N whoever lives N believes in me shall never die. believe u dis?
She says 2 him, yeah, Lord: I believe dat u r tha Christ, tha Son of God, which should come in2 tha world.
N when she had so said, she went her way, N called Mary her sister secretly, sayin, tha Master is come, N calls 4 u.
As soon as she heard dat, she arose quickly, N came 2 him.
Now Jesus was not yet come in2 tha town, but was in dat place where Martha met him.
Tha Jews then which were wit her in tha house, N comforted her, when dey saw Mary, dat she rose up hastily N went out, followed her, sayin, She goes 2 tha grave 2 weep there.
Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, N saw him, she fell down at his feet, sayin 2 him, Lord, if u had been here, my brother had not died.
When Jesus therefore saw her weepin, N tha Jews also weepin which came wit her, he groaned in tha spirit, N was troubled,
N said, Where have y’all laid him? dey said 2 him, Lord, come N see.
Jesus wept.
Then said tha Jews, look how he loved him!
N some of ’em said, Could not dis man, which opened tha eyes of tha blind, have caused dat even dis man should not have died?
Jesus therefore again groaning in himself comes 2 tha grave. It was a cave, N a stone lay upon it.
Jesus said, Take y’all away tha stone. Martha, tha sister of him dat was dead, says 2 him, Lord, by dis time he stinketh: 4 he has been dead four days.
Jesus says 2 her, Said I not 2 u, dat, if u would believe, u should see tha glory of God?
Then dey took away tha stone from tha place where tha dead was laid. N Jesus lifted up his eyes, N said, Father, I thank u dat u have heard me.
N I knew dat u hear me always: but because of tha people which stand by I said it, dat dey may believe dat u have sent me.
N when he like dis had spoken, he cried wit a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
N he dat was dead came forth, bound hand N foot wit graveclothes: N his face was bound about wit a napkin. Jesus says 2 ’em, Loose him, N let him go.
Then many of tha Jews which came 2 Mary, N had seen tha things which Jesus did, believed on him.
But some of ’em went their ways 2 tha Pharisees, N told ’em what things Jesus had done.
Then gathered tha chief priests N tha Pharisees a council, N said, What do we? 4 dis man does many miracles.
If we let him like dis alone, all men will believe on him: N tha Romans shall come N take away both our place N nation.
N one of ’em, named Caiaphas, bein tha high priest dat same year, said 2 ’em, y’all know nothing at all,
Nor consider dat it is expedient 4 us, dat one man should die 4 tha people, N dat tha whole nation perish not.
N dis spoke he not of himself: but bein high priest dat year, he prophesied dat Jesus should die 4 dat nation;
N not 4 dat nation only, but dat also he should gather together in one tha children of God dat were scattered abroad.
Then from dat day forth dey took counsel together 4 2 put him 2 death.
Jesus therefore walked no more openly among tha Jews; but went thence 2 a country near 2 tha wilderness, in2 a city called Ephraim, N there continued wit his disciples.
N tha Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: N many went out of tha country up 2 Jerusalem before tha passover, 2 purify themselves.
Then sought dey 4 Jesus, N spoke among themselves, as dey stood in tha temple, What think y’all, dat he will not come 2 tha feast?
Now both tha chief priests N tha Pharisees had given a commandment, dat, if any man knew where he were, he should show it, dat dey might take him.

12.text: Then Jesus six days before tha passover came 2 Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from tha dead.
There dey made him a supper; N Martha served: but Lazarus was one of ’em dat sat at tha table wit him.
Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, N anointed tha feet of Jesus, N wiped his feet wit her hair: N tha house was filled wit tha odour of tha ointment.
Then says one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, which should betray him,
Why was not dis ointment sold 4 three hundred pence, N given 2 tha poor?
Dis he said, not dat he cared 4 tha poor; but because he was a thief, N had tha bag, N bare what was put in it.
Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against tha day of my burying has she kept dis.
4 tha poor always y’all have wit u; but me y’all have not always.
Much people of tha Jews therefore knew dat he was there: N dey came not 4 Jesus’ sake only, but dat dey might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from tha dead.
But tha chief priests consulted dat dey might put Lazarus also 2 death;
Because dat by reason of him many of tha Jews went away, N believed on Jesus.
On tha next day much people dat were come 2 tha feast, when dey heard dat Jesus was comin 2 Jerusalem,
Took branches of palm trees, N went forth 2 meet him, N cried, Hosanna: Blessed is tha King of Israel dat comes in tha name of tha Lord.
N Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
Don’t fear, daughter of Sion: look, ur King comes, sittin on an ass’s colt.
Dese things understood not his disciples at tha first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered dey dat dese things were written of him, N dat dey had done dese things 2 him.
Tha people therefore dat was wit him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, N raised him from tha dead, bare record.
4 dis cause tha people also met him, 4 dat dey heard dat he had done dis miracle.
Tha Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive y’all how y’all prevail nothing? look, tha world is gone after him.
N there were certain Greeks among ’em dat came up 2 worship at tha feast:
Tha same came therefore 2 Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, N desired him, sayin, Sir, we would see Jesus.
Philip comes N tells Andrew: N again Andrew N Philip tell Jesus.
N Jesus answered ’em, sayin, tha hour is come, dat tha Son of man should be glorified.
For real, for real, I say 2 u, Except a corn of wheat fall in2 tha ground N die, it abides alone: but if it die, it brings forth much fruit.
He dat loves his life shall lose it; N he dat hates his life in dis world shall keep it 2 life eternal.
If any man serve me, let him follow me; N where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
Now is my soul troubled; N what shall I say? Father, save me from dis hour: but 4 dis cause came I 2 dis hour.
Father, glorify ur name. Then came there a voice from heaven, sayin, I have both glorified it, N will glorify it again.
Tha people therefore, dat stood by, N heard it, said dat it thundered: others said, an angel spoke 2 him.
Jesus answered, dis voice came not because of me, but 4 ur sakes.
Now is tha judgment of dis world: now shall tha prince of dis world be cast out.
N I, if I be lifted up from tha earth, will draw all men 2 me.
Dis he said, signifying what death he should die.
Tha people answered him, We have heard out of tha law dat Christ abides 4 ever: N how sayest u, tha Son of man must be lifted up? who is dis Son of man?
Then Jesus said 2 ’em, Yet a little while is tha light wit u. Walk while y’all have tha light, lest darkness come upon u: 4 he dat walks in darkness knows not where he goes.
While y’all have light, believe in tha light, dat y’all may be tha children of light. dese things spoke Jesus, N departed, N did hide himself from ’em.
But though he had done so many miracles before ’em, yet dey believed not on him:
Dat tha sayin of Esaias tha prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Lord, who has believed our report? N 2 whom has tha arm of tha Lord been revealed?
Therefore dey could not believe, because dat Esaias said again,
He has blinded their eyes, N hardened their heart; dat dey should not see wit their eyes, nor understand wit their heart, N be converted, N I should heal ’em.
Dese things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, N spoke of him.
Nevertheless among tha chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of tha Pharisees dey did not confess him, lest dey should be put out of tha synagogue:
4 dey loved tha praise of men more than tha praise of God.
Jesus cried N said, He dat believes on me, believes not on me, but on him dat sent me.
N he dat sees me sees him dat sent me.
I am come a light in2 tha world, dat whoever believes on me should not abide in darkness.
N if any man hear my words, N believe not, I judge him not: 4 I came not 2 judge tha world, but 2 save tha world.
He dat rejecteth me, N receives not my words, has one dat judges him: tha word dat I have spoken, tha same shall judge him in tha last day.
4 I have not spoken of myself; but tha Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, N what I should speak.
N I know dat his commandment is life everlasting: whatever I speak therefore, even as tha Father said 2 me, so I speak.

13.text: Now before tha feast of tha passover, when Jesus knew dat his hour was come dat he should depart out of dis world 2 tha Father, havin loved his own which were in tha world, he loved ’em 2 tha end.
N supper bein ended, tha devil havin now put in2 tha heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, 2 betray him;
Jesus knowin dat tha Father had given all things in2 his hands, N dat he was come from God, N went 2 God;
He rises from supper, N laid aside his garments; N took a towel, N girded himself.
After dat he pours water in2 a bason, N began 2 wash tha disciples’ feet, N 2 wipe ’em wit tha towel wherewith he was girded.
Then comes he 2 Simon Peter: N Peter says 2 him, Lord, do u wash my feet?
Jesus answered 2 him, What I do u know not now; but u will know hereafter.
Peter says 2 him, u will never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash u not, u have no part wit me.
Simon Peter says 2 him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands N my head.
Jesus says 2 him, He dat is washed needeth not save 2 wash his feet, but is clean every whit: N y’all r clean, but not all.
4 he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, y’all r not all clean.
So after he had washed their feet, N had taken his garments, N was set down again, he said 2 ’em, Know y’all what I have done 2 u?
y’all call me Master N Lord: N y’all say well; 4 so I am.
If I then, ur Lord N Master, have washed ur feet; y’all also ought 2 wash one another’s feet.
4 I have given u an example, dat y’all should do as I have done 2 u.
For real, for real, I say 2 u, tha servant is not greater than his lord; neither he dat is sent greater than he dat sent him.
If y’all know dese things, happy r y’all if y’all do ’em.
I speak not of u all: I know whom I have chosen: but dat tha scripture may be fulfilled, He dat eats bread wit me has lifted up his heel against me.
Now I tell u before it come, dat, when it is come 2 pass, y’all may believe dat I am he.
For real, for real, I say 2 u, He dat receives whoever I send receives me; N he dat receives me receives him dat sent me.
When Jesus had like dis said, he was troubled in spirit, N testified, N said, for real, for real, I say 2 u, dat one of u shall betray me.
Then tha disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spoke.
Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
Simon Peter therefore beckoned 2 him, dat he should ask who it should be of whom he spoke.
He then lyin on Jesus’ breast says 2 him, Lord, who is it?
Jesus answered, He it is, 2 whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. N when he had dipped tha sop, he gave it 2 Judas Iscariot, tha son of Simon.
N after tha sop Satan entered in2 him. Then said Jesus 2 him, dat u do, do quickly.
Now no man at tha table knew 4 what intent he spoke dis 2 him.
4 some of ’em thought, because Judas had tha bag, dat Jesus had said 2 him, Buy dose things dat we have need of against tha feast; or, dat he should give something 2 tha poor.
He then havin received tha sop went right away out: N it was night.
Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is tha Son of man glorified, N God is glorified in him.
If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, N shall right away glorify him.
Little children, yet a little while I am wit u. y’all shall seek me: N as I said 2 tha Jews, where I go, y’all cannot come; so now I say 2 u.
A new commandment I give 2 u, dat y’all love one another; as I have loved u, dat y’all also love one another.
By dis shall all men know dat y’all r my disciples, if y’all have love one 2 another.
Simon Peter said 2 him, Lord, where go u? Jesus answered him, where I go, u can not follow me now; but u will follow me afterwards.
Peter said 2 him, Lord, why cannot I follow u now? I will lay down my life 4 ur sake.
Jesus answered him, will u lay down ur life 4 my sake? for real, for real, I say 2 u, tha cock shall not crow, till u have denied me thrice.

14.text: Don’t let ur heart be troubled: y’all believe in God, believe also in me.
In my Father’s house r many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told u. I go 2 prepare a place 4 u.
N if I go N prepare a place 4 u, I will come again, N receive u 2 myself; dat where I am, there y’all may be also.
N where I go y’all know, N tha way y’all know.
Thomas says 2 him, Lord, we know not where u go; N how can we know tha way?
Jesus says 2 him, I am tha way, tha truth, N tha life: no man comes 2 tha Father, but by me.
If y’all had known me, y’all should have known my Father also: N from from now on y’all know him, N have seen him.
Philip says 2 him, Lord, show us tha Father, N it sufficeth us.
Jesus says 2 him, Have I been so long time wit u, N yet have u not known me, Philip? he dat has seen me has seen tha Father; N how sayest u then, show us tha Father?
Believe u not dat I am in tha Father, N tha Father in me? tha words dat I speak 2 u I speak not of myself: but tha Father dat lives in me, he does tha works.
Believe me dat I am in tha Father, N tha Father in me: or else believe me 4 tha very works’ sake.
For real, for real, I say 2 u, He dat believes on me, tha works dat I do shall he do also; N greater works than dese shall he do; because I go 2 my Father.
N whatever y’all shall ask in my name, dat will I do, dat tha Father may be glorified in tha Son.
If y’all shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
If y’all love me, keep my commandments.
N I will pray tha Father, N he shall give u another Comforter, dat he may abide wit u 4 ever;
Even tha Spirit of truth; whom tha world cannot receive, because it sees him not, neither knows him: but y’all know him; 4 he lives wit u, N shall be in u.
I will not leave u comfortless: I will come 2 u.
Yet a little while, N tha world sees me no more; but y’all see me: because I live, y’all shall live also.
At dat day y’all shall know dat I am in my Father, N y’all in me, N I in u.
He dat has my commandments, N keeps ’em, he it is dat loves me: N he dat loves me shall be loved of my Father, N I will love him, N will manifest myself 2 him.
Judas says 2 him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it dat u will manifest urself 2 us, N not 2 tha world?
Jesus answered 2 him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: N my Father will love him, N we will come 2 him, N make our stayed wit him.
He dat loves me not keeps not my sayings: N tha word which y’all hear is not mine, but tha Father’s which sent me.
Dese things have I spoken 2 u, bein yet present wit u.
But tha Comforter, which is tha Holy Ghost, whom tha Father will send in my name, he shall teach u all things, N bring all things 2 ur remembrance, whatever I have said 2 u.
Peace I leave wit u, my peace I give 2 u: not as tha world gives, give I 2 u. don’t let ur heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
y’all have heard how I said 2 u, I go away, N come again 2 u. If y’all loved me, y’all would rejoice, because I said, I go 2 tha Father: 4 my Father is greater than I.
N now I have told u before it come 2 pass, dat, when it is come 2 pass, y’all might believe.
Hereafter I will not talk much wit u: 4 tha prince of dis world comes, N has nothing in me.
But dat tha world may know dat I love tha Father; N as tha Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

15.text: I am tha true vine, N my Father is tha husbandman.
Every branch in me dat bears not fruit he takes away: N every branch dat bears fruit, he purgeth it, dat it may bring forth more fruit.
Now y’all r clean through tha word which I have spoken 2 u.
Abide in me, N I in u. As tha branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in tha vine; no more can y’all, except y’all abide in me.
I am tha vine, y’all r tha branches: He dat abides in me, N I in him, tha same brings forth much fruit: 4 without me y’all can do nothing.
If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, N is withered; N men gather ’em, N cast ’em in2 tha fire, N dey r burned.
If y’all abide in me, N my words abide in u, y’all shall ask what y’all will, N it will be done 2 u.
In dis is my Father glorified, dat y’all bear much fruit; so shall y’all be my disciples.
As tha Father has loved me, so have I loved u: continue y’all in my love.
If y’all keep my commandments, y’all shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, N abide in his love.
Dese things have I spoken 2 u, dat my joy might remain in u, N dat ur joy might be full.
Dis is my commandment, dat y’all love one another, as I have loved u.
Greater love has no man than dis, dat a man lay down his life 4 his friends.
y’all r my friends, if y’all do whatever I command u.
From now on I call u not servants; 4 tha servant knows not what his lord does: but I have called u friends; 4 all things dat I have heard of my Father I have made known 2 u.

y’all have not chosen me, but I have chosen u, N ordained u, dat y’all should go N bring forth fruit, N dat ur fruit should remain: dat whatever y’all shall ask of tha Father in my name, he may give it u.
Dese things I command u, dat y’all love one another.
If tha world hate u, y’all know dat it hated me before it hated u.
If y’all were of tha world, tha world would love his own: but because y’all r not of tha world, but I have chosen u out of tha world, therefore tha world hates u.
Remember tha word dat I said 2 u, tha servant is not greater than his lord. If dey have persecuted me, dey will also persecute u; if dey have kept my sayin, dey will keep urz also.
But all dese things will dey do 2 u 4 my name’s sake, because dey know not him dat sent me.
If I had not come N spoken 2 ’em, dey had not had sin: but now dey have no cloke 4 their sin.
He dat hates me hates my Father also.
If I had not done among ’em tha works which none other man did, dey had not had sin: but now have dey both seen N hated both me N my Father.
But dis comes 2 pass, dat tha word might be fulfilled dat is written in their law, dey hated me without a cause.
But when tha Comforter is come, whom I will send 2 u from tha Father, even tha Spirit of truth, which proceeds from tha Father, he shall testify of me:
N y’all also shall bear witness, because y’all have been wit me from tha beginning.

16.text: Dese things have I spoken 2 u, dat y’all should not be offended.
Dey shall put u out of tha synagogues: yeah, tha time comes, dat whoever kills u will think dat he does God service.
N dese things will dey do 2 u, because dey have not known tha Father, nor me.
But dese things have I told u, dat when tha time shall come, y’all may remember dat I told u of ’em. N dese things I said not 2 u at tha beginning, because I was wit u.
But now I go my way 2 him dat sent me; N none of u asks me, where go u?
But because I have said dese things 2 u, sorrow has filled ur heart.
Nevertheless I tell u tha truth; It is expedient 4 u dat I go away: 4 if I go not away, tha Comforter will not come 2 u; but if I depart, I will send him 2 u.
N when he is come, he will reprove tha world of sin, N of righteousness, N of judgment:
Of sin, because dey believe not on me;
Of righteousness, because I go 2 my Father, N y’all see me no more;
Of judgment, because tha prince of dis world is judged.
I have yet many things 2 say 2 u, but y’all cannot bear ’em now.
But when he, tha Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide u in2 all truth: 4 he shall not speak of himself; but whatever he shall hear, dat shall he speak: N he will show u things 2 come.
He shall glorify me: 4 he shall receive of mine, N shall show it 2 u.
All things dat tha Father has r mine: therefore said I, dat he shall take of mine, N shall show it 2 u.
A little while, N y’all shall not see me: N again, a little while, N y’all shall see me, because I go 2 tha Father.
Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is dis dat he says 2 us, A little while, N y’all shall not see me: N again, a little while, N y’all shall see me: N, Because I go 2 tha Father?
Dey said therefore, What is dis dat he says, A little while? we cannot tell what he says.
Now Jesus knew dat dey were desirous 2 ask him, N said 2 ’em, do y’all enquire among y’all of dat I said, A little while, N y’all shall not see me: N again, a little while, N y’all shall see me?
For real, for real, I say 2 u, dat y’all shall weep N lament, but tha world shall rejoice: N y’all shall be sorrowful, but ur sorrow shall be turned in2 joy.
A woman when she is in travail has sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of tha child, she remembereth no more tha anguish, 4 joy dat a man is born in2 tha world.
N y’all now therefore have sorrow: but I will see u again, N ur heart shall rejoice, N ur joy no man takes from u.
N in dat day y’all shall ask me nothing. for real, for real, I say 2 u, whatever y’all shall ask tha Father in my name, he will give it u.
Until now have y’all asked nothing in my name: ask, N y’all shall receive, dat ur joy may be full.
Dese things have I spoken 2 u in proverbs: but tha time comes, when I shall no more speak 2 u in proverbs, but I shall show u plainly of tha Father.
At dat day y’all shall ask in my name: N I say not 2 u, dat I will pray tha Father 4 u:
4 tha Father himself loves u, because y’all have loved me, N have believed dat I came out from God.
I came forth from tha Father, N am come in2 tha world: again, I leave tha world, N go 2 tha Father.
His disciples said 2 him, look, now speak u plainly, N speak no proverb.
Now r we sure dat u know all things, N needest not dat any man should ask u: by dis we believe dat u came forth from God.
Jesus answered ’em, do y’all now believe?
Look, tha hour comes, yeah, is now come, dat y’all shall be scattered, every man 2 his own, N shall leave me alone: N yet I am not alone, because tha Father is wit me.
Dese things I have spoken 2 u, dat in me y’all might have peace. In tha world y’all shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome tha world.

17.text: Dese words spoke Jesus, N lifted up his eyes 2 heaven, N said, Father, tha hour is come; glorify ur Son, dat ur Son also may glorify u:
As u have given him power over all flesh, dat he should give eternal life 2 as many as u have given him.
N dis is life eternal, dat dey might know u tha only true God, N Jesus Christ, whom u have sent.
I have glorified u on tha earth: I have finished tha work which u gave me 2 do.
N now, O Father, glorify u me wit ur own self wit tha glory which I had wit u before tha world was.
I have manifested ur name 2 tha men which u gave me out of tha world: thine dey were, N u gave ’em me; N dey have kept ur word.
Now dey have known dat all things whatever u have given me r of u.
4 I have given 2 ’em tha words which u gave me; N dey have received ’em, N have known surely dat I came out from u, N dey have believed dat u did send me.
I pray 4 ’em: I pray not 4 tha world, but 4 ’em which u have given me; 4 dey r thine.
N all mine r thine, N thine r mine; N I am glorified in ’em.
N now I am no more in tha world, but dese r in tha world, N I come 2 u. Holy Father, keep through ur own name dose whom u have given me, dat dey may be one, as we r.
While I was wit ’em in tha world, I kept ’em in ur name: dose dat u gave me I have kept, N none of ’em is lost, but tha son of perdition; dat tha scripture might be fulfilled.
N now come I 2 u; N dese things I speak in tha world, dat dey might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
I have given ’em ur word; N tha world has hated ’em, because dey r not of tha world, even as I am not of tha world.
I pray not dat u should take ’em out of tha world, but dat u should keep ’em from tha evil.
Dey r not of tha world, even as I am not of tha world.
Sanctify ’em through ur truth: ur word is truth.
As u have sent me in2 tha world, even so have I also sent ’em in2 tha world.
N 4 their sakes I sanctify myself, dat dey also might be sanctified through tha truth.
Neither pray I 4 dese alone, but 4 ’em also which shall believe on me through their word;
Dat dey all may be one; as u, Father, art in me, N I in u, dat dey also may be one in us: dat tha world may believe dat u have sent me.
N tha glory which u gave me I have given ’em; dat dey may be one, even as we r one:
I in ’em, N u in me, dat dey may be made perfect in one; N dat tha world may know dat u have sent me, N have loved ’em, as u have loved me.
Father, I will dat dey also, whom u have given me, be wit me where I am; dat dey may look my glory, which u have given me: 4 u lovedst me before tha foundation of tha world.
O righteous Father, tha world has not known u: but I have known u, N dese have known dat u have sent me.
N I have declared 2 ’em ur name, N will declare it: dat tha love wherewith u have loved me may be in ’em, N I in ’em.

18.text: When Jesus had spoken dese words, he went forth wit his disciples over tha brook Cedron, where was a garden, in2 tha which he entered, N his disciples.
N Judas also, which betrayed him, knew tha place: 4 Jesus ofttimes resorted there wit his disciples.
Judas then, havin received a band of men N officers from tha chief priests N Pharisees, comes there wit lanterns N torches N weapons.
Jesus therefore, knowin all things dat should come upon him, went forth, N said 2 ’em, Whom seek y’all?
Dey answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus says 2 ’em, I am he. N Judas also, which betrayed him, stood wit ’em.
As soon then as he had said 2 ’em, I am he, dey went backward, N fell 2 tha ground.
Then asked he ’em again, Whom seek y’all? N dey said, Jesus of Nazareth.
Jesus answered, I have told u dat I am he: if therefore y’all seek me, let dese go their way:
Dat tha sayin might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Of ’em which u gave me have I lost none.
Then Simon Peter havin a sword drew it, N struck tha high priest’s servant, N cut off his right ear. tha servant’s name was Malchus.
Then said Jesus 2 Peter, Put up ur sword in2 tha sheath: tha cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it?
Then tha band N tha captain N officers of tha Jews took Jesus, N bound him,
N led him away 2 Annas first; 4 he was father in law 2 Caiaphas, which was tha high priest dat same year.
Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel 2 tha Jews, dat it was expedient dat one man should die 4 tha people.
N Simon Peter followed Jesus, N so did another disciple: dat disciple was known 2 tha high priest, N went in wit Jesus in2 tha palace of tha high priest.
But Peter stood at tha door without. Then went out dat other disciple, which was known 2 tha high priest, N spoke 2 her dat kept tha door, N brought in Peter.
Then says tha damsel dat kept tha door 2 Peter, Art not u also one of dis man’s disciples? He says, I am not.
N tha servants N officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; 4 it was cold: N dey warmed themselves: N Peter stood wit ’em, N warmed himself.
Tha high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, N of his doctrine.
Jesus answered him, I spoke openly 2 tha world; I ever taught in tha synagogue, N in tha temple, where tha Jews always resort; N in secret have I said nothing.
Why ask u me? ask ’em which heard me, what I have said 2 ’em: look, dey know what I said.
N when he had like dis spoken, one of tha officers which stood by struck Jesus wit tha palm of his hand, sayin, answer u tha high priest so?
Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of tha evil: but if well, why smite u me?
Now Annas had sent him bound 2 Caiaphas tha high priest.
N Simon Peter stood N warmed himself. dey said therefore 2 him, Art not u also one of his disciples? He denied it, N said, I am not.
One of tha servants of tha high priest, bein his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see u in tha garden wit him?
Peter then denied again: N right away tha cock crew.
Then led dey Jesus from Caiaphas 2 tha hall of judgment: N it was early; N dey themselves went not in2 tha judgment hall, lest dey should be defiled; but dat dey might eat tha passover.
Pilate then went out 2 ’em, N said, What accusation bring y’all against dis man?
Dey answered 2 him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up 2 u.
Then said Pilate 2 ’em, Take y’all him, N judge him according 2 ur law. tha Jews therefore said 2 him, It is not lawful 4 us 2 put any man 2 death:
Dat tha sayin of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying what death he should die.
Then Pilate entered in2 tha judgment hall again, N called Jesus, N said 2 him, r u tha King of tha Jews?
Jesus answered him, Sayest u dis thing of urself, or did others tell it u of me?
Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? ur own nation N tha chief priests have delivered u 2 me: what have u done?
Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of dis world: if my kingdom were of dis world, then would my servants fight, dat I should not be delivered 2 tha Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

Pilate therefore said 2 him, r u a king then? Jesus answered, u sayest dat I am a king. 2 dis end was I born, N 4 dis cause came I in2 tha world, dat I should bear witness 2 tha truth. Every one dat is of tha truth hears my voice.
Pilate says 2 him, What is truth? N when he had said dis, he went out again 2 tha Jews, N says 2 ’em, I find in him no fault at all.
But y’all have a custom, dat I should release 2 u one at tha passover: will y’all therefore dat I release 2 u tha King of tha Jews?
Then cried dey all again, sayin, Not dis man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

19.text: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, N scourged him.
N tha soldiers platted a crown of thorns, N put it on his head, N dey put on him a purple robe,
N said, Hail, King of tha Jews! N dey struck him wit their hands.
