Pilate therefore went forth again, N says 2 ’em, look, I bring him forth 2 u, dat y’all may know dat I find no fault in him.
Then came Jesus forth, wearing tha crown of thorns, N tha purple robe. N Pilate says 2 ’em, look tha man!
When tha chief priests therefore N officers saw him, dey cried out, sayin, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate says 2 ’em, Take y’all him, N crucify him: 4 I find no fault in him.
Tha Jews answered him, We have a law, N by our law he ought 2 die, because he made himself tha Son of God.
When Pilate therefore heard dat sayin, he was tha more afraid;
N went again in2 tha judgment hall, N says 2 Jesus, from where r u? But Jesus gave him no answer.
Then says Pilate 2 him, speak u not 2 me? know u not dat I have power 2 crucify u, N have power 2 release u?
Jesus answered, u could have no power at all against me, except it were given u from above: therefore he dat delivered me 2 u has tha greater sin.
N from thenceforth Pilate sought 2 release him: but tha Jews cried out, sayin, If u let dis man go, u r not Cæsar’s friend: whoever makes himself a king speaks against Cæsar.
When Pilate therefore heard dat sayin, he brought Jesus forth, N sat down in tha judgment seat in a place dat is called tha Pavement, but in tha Hebrew, Gabbatha.
N it was tha preparation of tha passover, N about tha sixth hour: N he says 2 tha Jews, look ur King!
But dey cried out, Away wit him, away wit him, crucify him. Pilate says 2 ’em, Shall I crucify ur King? tha chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.
Then delivered he him therefore 2 ’em 2 be crucified. N dey took Jesus, N led him away.
N he bearin his cross went forth in2 a place called tha place of a skull, which is called in tha Hebrew Golgotha:
Where dey crucified him, N two other wit him, on either side one, N Jesus in tha midst.
N Pilate wrote a title, N put it on tha cross. N tha writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH tha KING OF tha JEWS.
Dis title then read many of tha Jews: 4 tha place where Jesus was crucified was nigh 2 tha city: N it was written in Hebrew, N Greek, N Latin.
Then said tha chief priests of tha Jews 2 Pilate, Write not, tha King of tha Jews; but dat he said, I am King of tha Jews.
Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
Then tha soldiers, when dey had crucified Jesus, took his garments, N made four parts, 2 every soldier a part; N also his coat: now tha coat was without seam, woven from tha top throughout.

Dey said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots 4 it, whose it shall be: dat tha scripture might be fulfilled, which says, dey parted my clothing among ’em, N 4 my vesture dey did cast lots. dese things therefore tha soldiers did.
Now there stood by tha cross of Jesus his mother, N his mother’s sister, Mary tha wife of Cleophas, N Mary Magdalene.
When Jesus therefore saw his mother, N tha disciple standin by, whom he loved, he says 2 his mother, Woman, look ur son!
Then says he 2 tha disciple, look ur mother! N from dat hour dat disciple took her 2 his own home.
After dis, Jesus knowin dat all things were now accomplished, dat tha scripture might be fulfilled, says, I thirst.
Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: N dey filled a spunge wit vinegar, N put it upon hyssop, N put it 2 his mouth.
When Jesus therefore had received tha vinegar, he said, It is finished: N he bowed his head, N gave up tha ghost.

Tha Jews therefore, because it was tha preparation, dat tha bodies should not remain upon tha cross on tha sabbath day, (4 dat sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate dat their legs might be broken, N dat dey might be taken away.
Then came tha soldiers, N broke tha legs of tha first, N of tha other which was crucified wit him.
But when dey came 2 Jesus, N saw dat he was dead already, dey broke not his legs:
But one of tha soldiers wit a spear pierced his side, N right away came there out blood N water.
N he dat saw it bare record, N his record is true: N he knows dat he says true, dat y’all might believe.
4 dese things were done, dat tha scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
N again another scripture says, dey shall look on him whom dey pierced.

N after dis Joseph of Arimathaea, bein a disciple of Jesus, but secretly 4 fear of tha Jews, besought Pilate dat he might take away tha body of Jesus: N Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, N took tha body of Jesus.
N there came also Nicodemus, which at tha first came 2 Jesus by night, N brought a mixture of myrrh N aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
Then took dey tha body of Jesus, N wound it in linen clothes wit tha spices, as tha manner of tha Jews is 2 bury.
Now in tha place where he was crucified there was a garden; N in tha garden a new sepulchre, in which was never man yet laid.
There laid dey Jesus therefore because of tha Jews’ preparation day; 4 tha sepulchre was nigh at hand.

20.text: Tha first day of tha week comes Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, 2 tha sepulchre, N sees tha stone taken away from tha sepulchre.
Then she runs, N comes 2 Simon Peter, N 2 tha other disciple, whom Jesus loved, N says 2 ’em, dey have taken away tha Lord out of tha sepulchre, N we know not where dey have laid him.
Peter therefore went forth, N dat other disciple, N came 2 tha sepulchre.
So dey ran both together: N tha other disciple did outrun Peter, N came first 2 tha sepulchre.
N he stooping down, N lookin in, saw tha linen clothes lyin; yet went he not in.
Then comes Simon Peter followin him, N went in2 tha sepulchre, N sees tha linen clothes lie,
N tha napkin, dat was about his head, not lyin wit tha linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
Then went in also dat other disciple, which came first 2 tha sepulchre, N he saw, N believed.
4 as yet dey knew not tha scripture, dat he must rise again from tha dead.
Then tha disciples went away again 2 their own home.
But Mary stood without at tha sepulchre weepin: N as she wept, she stooped down, N looked in2 tha sepulchre,
N sees two angels in white sittin, tha one at tha head, N tha other at tha feet, where tha body of Jesus had lain.
N dey say 2 her, Woman, why weepest u? She says 2 ’em, Because dey have taken away my Lord, N I know not where dey have laid him.
N when she had like dis said, she turned herself back, N saw Jesus standin, N knew not dat it was Jesus.
Jesus says 2 her, Woman, why weepest u? whom seek u? She, supposing him 2 be tha gardener, says 2 him, Sir, if u have borne him hence, tell me where u have laid him, N I will take him away.
Jesus says 2 her, Mary. She turned herself, N says 2 him, Rabboni; which is 2 say, Master.
Jesus says 2 her, Touch me not; 4 I am not yet ascended 2 my Father: but go 2 my brothers, N say 2 ’em, I ascend 2 my Father, N ur Father; N 2 my God, N ur God.
Mary Magdalene came N told tha disciples dat she had seen tha Lord, N dat he had spoken dese things 2 her.

Then tha same day at evening, bein tha first day of tha week, when tha doors were shut where tha disciples were assembled 4 fear of tha Jews, came Jesus N stood in tha midst, N says 2 ’em, Peace be 2 u.
N when he had so said, he showed 2 ’em his hands N his side. Then were tha disciples glad, when dey saw tha Lord.
Then said Jesus 2 ’em again, Peace be 2 u: as my Father has sent me, even so send I u.
N when he had said dis, he breathed on ’em, N says 2 ’em, Receive y’all tha Holy Ghost:
Whose soever sins y’all remit, dey r remitted 2 ’em; N whose soever sins y’all retain, dey r retained.
But Thomas, one of tha twelve, called Didymus, was not wit ’em when Jesus came.

Tha other disciples therefore said 2 him, We have seen tha Lord. But he said 2 ’em, Except I shall see in his hands tha print of tha nails, N put my finger in2 tha print of tha nails, N thrust my hand in2 his side, I will not believe.
N after eight days again his disciples were within, N Thomas wit ’em: then came Jesus, tha doors bein shut, N stood in tha midst, N said, Peace be 2 u.
Then says he 2 Thomas, Reach here ur finger, N look my hands; N reach here ur hand, N thrust it in2 my side: N don’t be faithless, but believin.
N Thomas answered 2 him, My Lord N my God.
Jesus says 2 him, Thomas, because u have seen me, u have believed: blessed r dey dat have not seen, N yet have believed.
N many other signs truly did Jesus in tha presence of his disciples, which r not written in dis book:
But dese r written, dat y’all might believe dat Jesus is tha Christ, tha Son of God; N dat believin y’all might have life through his name.

21.text: After dese things Jesus showed himself again 2 tha disciples at tha sea of Tiberias; N on dis wise showed he himself.
There were together Simon Peter, N Thomas called Didymus, N Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, N tha sons of Zebedee, N two other of his disciples.
Simon Peter says 2 ’em, I go a fishing. dey say 2 him, We also go wit u. dey went forth, N entered in2 a ship right away; N dat night dey caught nothing.
But when tha morning was now come, Jesus stood on tha shore: but tha disciples knew not dat it was Jesus.
Then Jesus says 2 ’em, Children, have y’all any food? dey answered him, No.
N he said 2 ’em, Cast tha net on tha right side of tha ship, N y’all shall find. dey cast therefore, N now dey were not able 2 draw it 4 tha crowd of fishes.

Therefore dat disciple whom Jesus loved says 2 Peter, It is tha Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard dat it was tha Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat 2 him, (4 he was naked,) N did cast himself in2 tha sea.
N tha other disciples came in a little ship; (4 dey were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging tha net wit fishes.
As soon then as dey were come 2 land, dey saw a fire of coals there, N fish laid thereon, N bread.
Jesus says 2 ’em, Bring of tha fish which y’all have now caught.
Simon Peter went up, N drew tha net 2 land full of great fishes, an hundred N fifty N three: N 4 all there were so many, yet was not tha net broken.
Jesus says 2 ’em, Come N dine. N none of tha disciples dared ask him, Who r u? knowin dat it was tha Lord.
Jesus then comes, N takes bread, N gives ’em, N fish likewise.
Dis is now tha third time dat Jesus showed himself 2 his disciples, after dat he was risen from tha dead.
So when dey had dined, Jesus says 2 Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, love u me more than dese? He says 2 him, yeah, Lord; u know dat I love u. He says 2 him, Feed my lambs.
He says 2 him again tha second time, Simon, son of Jonas, love u me? He says 2 him, yeah, Lord; u know dat I love u. He says 2 him, Feed my sheep.

He says 2 him tha third time, Simon, son of Jonas, love u me? Peter was grieved because he said 2 him tha third time, love u me? N he said 2 him, Lord, u know all things; u know dat I love u. Jesus says 2 him, Feed my sheep.

For real, for real, I say 2 u, When u were young, u girdedst urself, N walkedst where u would: but when u will be old, u will stretch forth ur hands, N another shall gird u, N carry u where u would not.
Dis spoke he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. N when he had spoken dis, he says 2 him, Follow me.
Then Peter, turnin about, sees tha disciple whom Jesus loved followin; which also leaned on his breast at supper, N said, Lord, which is he dat betrayeth u?
Peter seein him says 2 Jesus, Lord, N what shall dis man do?
Jesus says 2 him, If I will dat he tarry till I come, what is dat 2 u? follow u me.
Then went dis sayin abroad among tha brothers, dat dat disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not 2 him, He shall not die; but, If I will dat he tarry till I come, what is dat 2 u?
Dis is tha disciple which testifieth of dese things, N wrote dese things: N we know dat his testimony is true.
N there r also many other things which Jesus did, tha which, if dey should be written every one, I suppose dat even tha world itself could not contain tha books dat should be written. Amen.
